title: SourceUnitValue
description: Value posted onto the SourceUnit panel: symbol-level interpretations inside a single language/format unit. Pack-owned. Examples used by the Repository Sourcing Pack: CodeUnit (carries SCIP SymbolInformation), JpaEntity, ProtoMessage, GraphqlSchema, IacResource.

sourceIdentityKey.description: Stable per-source identity for this unit (e.g. fully-qualified symbol).
